---
title: "DEP analysis"
description: "Run Recommended DEP on observed pre-imputation data, preserve presence/absence evidence, reproduce archived results, or compare advanced proteomics engines."
---

## Recommended DEP is the default

ProtVis 0.9.1 changed the default differential-protein workflow to reduce dependence on imputed values and historical matrix shifts.

Current Recommended DEP defaults are:

| Setting | Default |
|---|---|
| Input matrix | observed `Step4_data_transformed` |
| Sample adjustment | median-center samples |
| Missing-value treatment | **no KNN imputation in the inferential matrix** |
| Detection filter | detected in ≥2 replicates in both groups |
| Statistical test | limma robust `eBayes`, `trend=TRUE`, `robust=TRUE` |
| Effect-size label threshold | `|log2FC| ≥ 1` |
| Significance criterion | `adj.P.Val` |
| FDR cutoff | 0.05 |
| Multiple testing | BH |
| Volcano y axis | raw `P.Value` by default for display |

`limma::treat()` is also available when the minimum effect size should be incorporated into the hypothesis test rather than applied only after testing.

## Current versus archived mode

The **DEP mode** selector provides:

- **Recommended DEP** — use for new analyses;
- **Archived reproduction** — uses the historical Step6 normalized matrix/settings for exact comparability with older figures.

Archived reproduction can retain the historical matrix shift; do not use it merely because it produces more significant proteins.

## Comparison table

Comparisons are still defined by two columns:

```text
Group1,Group2
Control,Treatment
Root,Shoot
```

Multiple rows are allowed. Group labels must match `sample_info` values exactly. The built-in demo retains the archived B73/Y12 developmental comparisons.

## Detection filter

Recommended choices include:

- detected in ≥N replicates in **both** groups (default);
- detected in ≥N replicates in **either** group;
- any comparison sample (archived behavior);
- all proteins.

The default minimum detected replicates is 2.

## Parallel presence/absence evidence

Proteins detected in at least the configured number of replicates in one group but zero times in the other are retained as a separate table/evidence stream. This is intentionally **not** converted into an arbitrary huge logFC by filling the missing group.

DEP Summary can export both:

- **quantitative DEP counts**;
- **parallel evidence counts**.

Current interface now defaults to observed-data Recommended DEP with detection filtering, robust limma/BH FDR and separate presence-absence evidence." width="100%" fig-align="center"}

Review results in this order: **full result table → statistical thresholds/method metadata → volcano → heatmap → summary/evidence tables**. Visual thresholds should never be the only stored definition of significance.

## Additional statistical engines

ProtVis also provides an independent statistical-engine workspace for:

- **limma** — robust/trend empirical-Bayes protein-level model;
- **DEqMS** — uses peptide/PSM evidence counts when available;
- **proDA** — models dropout/missingness and is suited to pre-imputation abundance data;
- **MSstats** — uses native feature-level long-format data when the project contains it.

Availability is checked per engine. If required inputs/packages are missing, the run summary reports the engine as unavailable rather than silently substituting another method.

## Output

DEP results are appended to schema-v4 history and remain available to enrichment/GSEA loaders. Compatibility files include `Step7_differential_analysis.rda`; the advanced engine workspace can also write `Step7_DEP_engines.rda`.

::: {.callout-important}
For publication, define the final significance rule with the adjusted/FDR metric and effect-size criterion you actually used. The default volcano can display raw P on the y-axis while classification still uses adjusted P/FDR; these are different roles.
:::
